newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Comercial Portugues Q1 net up.
newsitem.headline: Banco Comercial Portugues Q1 net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Figures given in escudos (PTE) and NOT U.S. dollars.
The company attributed a decrease in earnings per share to a dilution effect arising from its share capital increase from PTE 109,686 million to PTE 136,686 million in the second quarter of 1996.

The company also said the higher net income in the first quarter of 1997 reflected an increase in net interest margin, the reduction of risk-provisioning requirements, buoyant commissions and trading income, and lower staff costs.
The company said income for the first quarter of 1997 in U.S. dollars was $40.1 million, up 12.2 percent from last year.
